commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "SNAPSHOT-FAILED"
fi

ls .changeset/ | head; echo "---sample---"; git show 9cd8457cdbf9614bd576d0959e9560a43c697a3b:.changeset/config.json 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "no config"; echo "---existing changeset example---"; for f in $(git show 9cd8457cdbf9614bd576d0959e9560a43c697a3b --stat --name-only --format= 2>/dev/null); do :; done; git log -1 --format= --name-only origin/main -- .changeset 2>/dev/null | head

git show 9cd8457cdbf9614bd576d0959e9560a43c697a3b:scripts/consolidate-changesets.py 2>/dev/null | grep -n "bump\|Fixed\|Added\|VALID\|type" | head -30; echo "==other changesets=="; git ls-tree 9cd8457cdbf9614bd576d0959e9560a43c697a3b .changeset/ | head

git status --porcelain; echo "---CPD---"; echo "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=[${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-UNSET}]"; echo "---MKTEMP-IN-REPO?---"; d=$(mktemp -d); ( cd "$d" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>&1 ); echo "rev-parse-rc=$?"; rm -rf "$d"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
